title: aglaia aphanamixis
intro: Aglaia aphanamixis, commonly known as the 'Bael tree' or 'Malaysian Ironwood', is a plant species native to Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Aglaia aphanamixis include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
